_driver_source.driver.f:
PROGRAM HOLDSOLVE
      IMPLICIT DOUBLE PRECISION (A-H,O-Z)
      DIMENSION A(4,4), B(4,1), INDEX(4,3)
      INTEGER ISING
      DOUBLE PRECISION DETERM
      COMMON /MACHIN/ MACH
      MACH=1
      A(1,1)=100D0
      A(1,2)=-50D0
      A(1,3)=0D0
      A(1,4)=0D0
      A(2,1)=-50D0
      A(2,2)=150D0
      A(2,3)=-60D0
      A(2,4)=0D0
      A(3,1)=0D0
      A(3,2)=-60D0
      A(3,3)=180D0
      A(3,4)=-70D0
      A(4,1)=0D0
      A(4,2)=0D0
      A(4,3)=-70D0
      A(4,4)=140D0
      B(1,1)=250D0
      B(2,1)=-340D0
      B(3,1)=295D0
      B(4,1)=-35D0
      M=1
      ISING=0
      CALL INVERD(4,A,4,B,1,DETERM,ISING,INDEX)
      IF (ISING .NE. 1) WRITE(6,*) 'ISING',ISING
      WRITE(6,'(A1)') 'S'
      WRITE(6,'(4(ES25.17,1X))') (B(I,1),I=1,4)
      WRITE(6,*) 'DET', DETERM
      STOP
      END
